ns2:course.label: Incompressible Flow
ns2:course.description: Equations of motion for incompressible flow, both inviscid and viscous; potential flow theory, inviscid airfoil theory: two- and three-dimensional, Navier-Stokes equations, laminar boundary layer and transition to turbulence. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in AE 202 and MATH 241.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in AE 202 and MATH 241.
